data.long_meaning: Pururav is the name of a legendary king in Hindu mythology, who was a descendant of King Puru. The name Pururav carries the meaning “Descendant of King Puru” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Pururav usually hope their child will grow to embody descendant of king puru and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes royal lineage and divine ancestry.
data.etymology: Pururav belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Descendant of King Puru.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pururav total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: Pururav was a great ruler and fighter, renowned for his valour and wisdom. He is remembered for his leadership and his role in preserving the lineage of the Kuru dynasty.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Pururav is a reminder of the values associated with great leadership and spiritual wisdom. It serves as an inspiration for individuals to strive towards becoming righteous leaders and seek knowledge and understanding of the deeper truths of life. Additionally, the name can be seen as a reflection of the belief in the cyclical nature of time and the importance of preserving lineages and traditions for future generations.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Pururav is a name revered in Hindu mythology, symbolizing boundless love and devotion. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Puru' (ancient, primeval) and 'Rav' (joy), it signifies the eternal bliss and ancient wisdom that flows from a deeply loving and dedicated heart.

vedic_reference.note: The name of the first king of the lunar dynasty, Pururavas, is mentioned in the Vedas. He is the son of Ila and the husband of Urvasi.

historical_references.reference: Pururavas are mentioned in the Mahabharata as ancestors of the Kuru dynasty. The name Pururav is associated with the legendary king Ikshvaku, who is believed to have founded the Ikshvaku dynasty, which is considered the earliest dynasty in Hindu mythology.
historical_references.context: ancestors of the Kuru dynasty, legendary king, Ikshvaku dynasty, Hindu mythology

historical_references.reference: According to the Puranas, Pururav was a king of Haihayas, a branch of the solar dynasty, and he ruled over the region of Mathura in North India. He is also known as Puru, the father of the famous king Prithu, whom Puranic texts depict as an agricultural deity.
